newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline, bucking trend, holds steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline, bucking trend, holds steady.

text.p: NWE gasoline, bucking weakness in crude and gas oil, held steady on Wednesday after bullish U.S. inventory data.

API data last night said gasoline supplies fell 3.8 million barrels while the EIA on Wednesday said stocks fell a more modest 1.2 million. But several traders said gasoline's fundamentals have been bullish thanks to an open arbitrage to the U.S. and lower European output.
Eurograde barges traded at $225 and $228 fob ARA, and at $226.50 and $226.75 fob Amsterdam and Rotterdam. In late trading it was heard up about $1 from Tuesday to trade $227.
